name: Villasabariego (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, red above and below and yellow at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villasabariego (a shell and a bridge above waves on blue).
history: The flag is square, of proportions 1:1, quartered per saltire, the upper and lower triangles red and the lateral ones yellow, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: division per saltire, red above and below
Villasabariego arms — shell and bridge above waves on blue
